spanish: Y si altar de piedras harás a mí, no las edificarás labradas; porque tu espada balanceaste sobre él, y lo profanaste.

findings.issue: גָּזִית is a feminine singular noun; labradas is a feminine plural adjective and changes that number.
The suffixes are 3rd feminine singular, so they cannot be the masculine altar; él and lo make that masculine referent.

notes: Y si, altar de piedras, harás, a mí, no, las edificarás, tu espada, and profanaste match the remaining tokens.
